name: Jaipur The Rose
poem: Rose sandstone, small windows and a street full of detail. Let your eye move from one projecting balcony to the next.

landmarks.name: Hawa Mahal
landmarks.description: A five-storey pink sandstone palace with projecting latticed windows. Its street-facing facade is a defining Jaipur landmark.

landmarks.name: Amber Fort
landmarks.description: A hilltop palace-fort near Jaipur, known for courtyards and a mix of sandstone and marble.

landmarks.name: City Palace
landmarks.description: A palace complex in Jaipur with courtyards, museums and buildings added over time.

name: Jodhpur The Indigo
poem: Blue houses gather below the ridge. The fort and the city hold two different scales in the same view.

landmarks.name: Mehrangarh Fort
landmarks.description: A large fort on a rocky ridge above Jodhpur. Its walls and palace buildings rise over the old city.

landmarks.name: Jaswant Thada
landmarks.description: A white marble memorial associated with Maharaja Jaswant Singh II.

landmarks.name: Umaid Bhawan Palace
landmarks.description: A palace in Jodhpur with a royal residence, museum and hotel.

name: Jaisalmer The Golden
poem: Golden stone catches the light. Inside the walls, the fort remains part of a living city.

landmarks.name: The Living Fort
landmarks.description: Jaisalmer Fort is a living settlement, with homes, shops and temples within its sandstone walls.

landmarks.name: Patwon Ki Haveli
landmarks.description: A group of five havelis in Jaisalmer, known for carved sandstone facades.

landmarks.name: Sam Sand Dunes
landmarks.description: A dune landscape near Jaisalmer. Check local conditions and responsible operators before any visit.

name: Udaipur The White
poem: Light moves across the lake while the palace keeps its long line along the shore.

landmarks.name: Lake Pichola
landmarks.description: Lake Pichola has the islands of Jagniwas and Jagmandir, with the City Palace along its eastern bank.

landmarks.name: City Palace of Udaipur
landmarks.description: A palace complex overlooking Lake Pichola, with balconies, towers and cupolas.

landmarks.name: Jag Mandir
landmarks.description: A palace on an island in Lake Pichola, distinct from the Lake Palace on Jagniwas.

name: The Thar The Silence
poem: Sand holds the marks of wind and passing feet. Look closer for scrub, stone and the signs of life.

landmarks.name: The Dunes
landmarks.description: Dunes are one part of the Thar landscape, alongside rocky ground and desert vegetation.

landmarks.name: Desert National Park
landmarks.description: A protected landscape near Jaisalmer with dunes, rocks and important desert wildlife habitat. A sighting is never guaranteed.

landmarks.name: Khuri Village
landmarks.description: A village near Jaisalmer associated with nearby desert dunes. This illustration is not a village reconstruction.

name: Pushkar The Divine
poem: Steps meet water at the ghats. Give the lake and the people who worship here room to be themselves.

landmarks.name: Pushkar Lake
landmarks.description: A sacred lake ringed by bathing ghats. Respect worship, local customs and any site rules.

landmarks.name: Brahma Temple
landmarks.description: A temple in Pushkar dedicated to Brahma, recognised by its red spire.

landmarks.name: Savitri Temple
landmarks.description: A hilltop temple overlooking Pushkar. Check local access and conditions before a visit.
